StudyPY

Full-Stack • CS Education Hub

Centralized Learning Platform with In-Browser Multi-Language Sandbox

Source

A full-stack learning platform and interactive coding environment created for IT and Computer Science students. Features real-time code execution with the OnlineCompiler API, interactive algorithms visualizers, and a decoupled Node.js / Express backend server.

Key Features & Highlights
  • ▸In-browser code execution for Python, Java, C/C++, JavaScript, and PHP
  • ▸Interactive SVG visualizers for Git branching and DSA concepts
  • ▸Decoupled Node.js & Express API backend for compiler proxying and requests
  • ▸Clean, responsive interface built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3

TermChat

Systems & CLI

Cross-Platform Terminal Messaging Suite & Encrypted File Vault

Source

A decentralized terminal UI communication and file-sharing tool. Features encrypted room messaging, zero-trust tokens, interactive terminal navigation, and cross-platform terminal releases.

Key Features & Highlights
  • ▸Device identity key verification & zero-trust room tokens
  • ▸Interactive Shared Files Vault with 1-command downloads (/files, /get)
  • ▸Ephemeral channels with /destroy and self-destruct countdown timers
  • ▸Multi-platform support for Linux, macOS, Windows, and Termux
